vectors.name: Invalidate Issuer Signature Bit-Flip
vectors.description: Flips the final character in base64url JWS signature segment to verify cryptographic rejection.

vectors.name: Key Binding Nonce Mismatch Injection
vectors.description: Replaces the verifier's challenge nonce in the KB-JWT payload with a mismatched random UUID.

vectors.name: Strip Disclosure Without Updating sd_hash
vectors.description: Removes a disclosure segment from the SD-JWT stream while keeping KB-JWT intact, testing sd_hash tamper detection.

vectors.name: Presentation Replay Attack (Consumed JTI)
vectors.description: Resubmits an identical presentation with a previously consumed JTI to test nonce/JTI replay cache.

vectors.name: Expired Credential Presentation Injection
vectors.description: Injects an expiration timestamp from 24 hours in the past into the credential payload.

vectors.name: Malformed Recursive SD Nesting Injection
vectors.description: Injects a malformed recursive _sd structure missing matching salt/hash disclosures.

vectors.name: INJIVER-1131 Credential Type Mismatch Injection
vectors.description: Submits an SD-JWT with an unrequested credential type (e.g. driving_licence instead of national_id) to verify RP-side type validation.

vectors.name: ASN.1 DER Signature Transcoding Attack
vectors.description: Transcodes standard 64-byte IEEE P1363 signature into variable-length ASN.1 DER to verify Nimbus JOSE format enforcement.
